Run SoftEther Linux client commands through vpncmd. Examples include AccountList, NicList, and AccountStatusGet home.

Use commands to configure TAP certificates, proxies, accounts, and advanced connection settings. Management is local by default. To manage the client from a computer, explicitly enable remote management. Session keys and credentials are hidden from command output.

To configure certificate or anonymous authentication, or a proxy, enable “%1$s” in advanced TAP management. The app uses the logical adapter home (NicCreate home) for Android and binds the automatically managed home account to it. Other SoftEther virtual adapters can have different names.

After setting up authentication and server certificate verification, run AccountConnect home. The app detects the connection and lets Android configure the %2$s. In management mode, create accounts and initiate connections manually, including accounts saved to connect at startup.

vpncmd parses the command file.
